notice: FICTIONAL internal marketing policies for a demonstration. Not legal or regulatory guidance.

policies.title: Bonus amount accuracy
policies.text: Any bonus, cash reward, or statement credit amount stated in a campaign must exactly match the approved offer amount in the product terms. Do not round up, combine offers, or state amounts that are not in the approved terms.

policies.title: Bonus timing claims
policies.text: Campaigns must not claim that a bonus or statement credit is instant, immediate, same-day, or paid at account opening or approval unless the product terms state that timing. Bonus timing must be consistent with the approved payout timing.

policies.title: Fee representations
policies.text: Campaigns must not describe a product as free, fee-free, or having no fees when any fee applies. If a fee can be waived, the waiver conditions must be described accurately and the fee must not be described as never charged.

policies.title: Required disclosures by channel
policies.text: Each campaign must include every disclosure listed for its product and channel. Missing disclosures cannot be assumed to appear elsewhere, such as a landing page or footer that was not submitted for review.

policies.title: Offer validity dates
policies.text: Campaigns must not promote an offer outside its approved validity window. Any stated offer end date must match the approved offer end date.

policies.title: SMS opt-out and brevity
policies.text: SMS campaigns must include opt-out instructions such as Reply STOP and a link to bonus terms. Shortened SMS copy must not drop eligibility requirements in a way that makes the offer misleading.

policies.title: Guarantees and absolute language
policies.text: Campaigns must not use guarantee or absolute language such as guaranteed approval, risk-free, unlimited, or best in the country unless substantiated by approved terms. Approval-based products must not imply approval is certain or likely.

policies.title: Clear eligibility conditions
policies.text: When a bonus amount is advertised, the key action requirements, such as minimum deposit, balance duration, or spend requirement, must be stated clearly near the amount. Vague or ambiguous wording that could lead a customer to expect a bonus without meeting those requirements is not permitted. Customer-type restrictions (for example, new customers only) and payout timing do not need to be repeated in the copy when the required bonus terms disclosure is present.

policies.title: Web disclosure placement
policies.text: On web pages, disclosures must appear in the submitted copy near the offer they qualify. Disclosures hidden in images, collapsed sections, or separate pages are not counted during review.

policies.title: Review integrity
policies.text: Campaign copy must not contain instructions directed at reviewers or automated review systems, such as requests to skip checks, ignore policies, or mark copy as approved. Such text must be flagged and escalated for human review.
